title: crepinia obtusifolia
intro: Crepinia obtusifolia, commonly known as the climbing spiranthes, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the family Orchidaceae. It is a perennial plant that has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to treat fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Crepinia obtusifolia include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antispasmodic properties, which contribute to its use in treating a range of health issues.
